newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-I'M IN NO RUSH TO FIND NEW CLUB, KLINSMANN SAYS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-I'M IN NO RUSH TO FIND NEW CLUB, KLINSMANN SAYS.

text.p: Germany captain Juergen Klinsmann said on Thursday he was in no hurry to find a new club for next season and had yet to agree a deal with any foreign team.

Klinsmann, who is giving up a lucrative contract at Bayern Munich at the end of the season because he is unhappy with the atmosphere at the club, was linked with Real Madrid on Thursday but is also believed to be wanted by England's Everton.
But the 32-year-old striker said: "Real is one of Europe's leading clubs but I have not spoken to anyone at Real.

"I don't think much of speculation like this. I have made a point of putting off the transfer business. There is no point in making decisions in a hurry. At the moment there is nothing specific to report at all."

Klinsmann has said he plans to move abroad when he takes advantage of an opt-out clause in his contract at Bayern. The forward has played in most of Europe's major leagues -- Italy, Germany, England and France -- but has yet to play in Spain.
The player is known to enjoy life in southern Europe and has a passion for new cultures and languages.
